data.name: Basith
data.gender_notes: Basith is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The one who is the ruler and controller of the earth, representing stability, grounding, and nurturing energy. The name Basith carries the meaning “Lord of the Earth” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Tamil, Malayalam. Parents who choose Basith usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of the earth and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for a child who is destined to embody the divine power of the earth and provide stability and nurturing to those around him.
data.etymology: Basith belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord of the Earth.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Basith total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

data.cultural_impact: The name Basith is of Hindu-Sanskrit origin and it instills a sense of sovereignty, authority, and stability. This name was given to children in ancient times who were expected to grow up to become the pillars of their families and communities. Basith is a strong and powerful name that is associated with leaders, kings, and rulers. It evokes images of strength, stability, and resilience.
data.spiritual_significance: In Hindu spirituality, the earth is considered as the physical manifestation of the divine mother, and the one who nurtures and sustains all life. The name Basith signifies the inherent earthly power, grounding energy, and nurturing qualities within an individual. It serves as a reminder to remain rooted in the present moment while striving towards spiritual growth. Additionally, the name's association with stability and strength can provide comfort and protection to the bearer throughout their life journey.
